name: ecoctx
description: An audit of what your coding agent reads before it does anything, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: ecoctx
plugins.description: Grade every prediction against what the fix actually bought, not just measure what loads. ecoctx audits your coding agent's standing context cost in tokens - CLAUDE.md, indexes, every installed skill's description - and ranks what can really be changed. Sixteen steps, two phases, a record another person can check.
